description: This script runs a Flask backend server using Gunicorn, facilitating development by automating the server startup process. It locates the backend directory within the project structure, switches the working directory to it, and executes the Gunicorn command with specified options.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Main function that locates the backend directory, switches to it, and runs Gunicorn. Handles errors if the directory is missing or Gunicorn is not installed.
